entries.summaryZh: 1555年10月，毛利元就率军约四千人在安艺国严岛登陆，突袭陶晴贤的两万余人大营。毛利军趁暴风雨夜渡海，拂晓发起强攻，陶军全线溃败，陶晴贤自尽。此役使毛利氏吞并周防、长门，成为西日本最强的势力，也奠定了元就作为谋略家的名声。
entries.summaryEn: In October 1555 Mori Motonari landed on the sacred island of Miyajima with roughly four thousand men and stormed the far larger camp of the Ouchi retainer Sue Harukata. Crossing by night in a storm, the Mori attack broke the Sue army at dawn; Harukata took his own life and the victory gave the Mori control of western Honshu.
entries.significanceZh: 严岛之战使毛利氏取代大内氏称雄西日本，是战国中期势力重组的关键一战。
entries.significanceEn: Miyajima replaced Ouchi dominance in western Japan with that of the Mori and reshaped the balance of the Sengoku period.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基记天文二十四年十月初一（1555年10月16日），英文维基只记1555年；本条保留年份精度。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia gives 16 October 1555 while English Wikipedia records only the year; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1805年10月30日，马塞纳元帅率法军在维罗纳以东的卡尔迪耶罗迎战卡尔大公统率的奥军，属第三次反法同盟战争。法军约三万三千人实际参战，奥军投入约四万九千人，双方激战整日，奥军守住阵地，法军未能取得决定性突破，随后因乌尔姆战局变化而撤退。
entries.summaryEn: On 30 October 1805, during the War of the Third Coalition, Massena's French army attacked Archduke Charles's Austrians at Caldiero, fifteen kilometres east of Verona. About 33,000 French faced some 49,000 Austrians; the fighting lasted a full day without a decisive result before the French withdrew as the Ulm campaign closed.
entries.significanceZh: 卡尔迪耶罗之战是1805年意大利战场规模最大的交战，牵制了卡尔大公统率的奥军主力。
entries.significanceEn: Caldiero was the largest engagement of the 1805 Italian campaign and kept Archduke Charles's main Austrian army occupied.
entries.notesZh: 卡尔迪耶罗在1796、1805、1809与1813年都有战事，本条专指1805年之战；中英文维基均系于10月30日。
entries.notesEn: Caldiero saw fighting in 1796, 1805, 1809 and 1813; this entry is the 1805 battle, which both Wikipedia articles date to 30 October.

entries.summaryZh: 1900年8月14日至15日，八国联军在义和团运动期间攻入北京，为被围困的东交民巷外国公使馆解围。自6月20日起，义和团与清军围攻使馆区，各国使馆人员、卫队与侨民困守近两个月。联军破城后解围，慈禧太后与光绪帝西逃，清朝被迫议和并签订《辛丑条约》。
entries.summaryEn: On 14 and 15 August 1900 the Eight-Nation Alliance captured Beijing and relieved the foreign legations at Dongjiaomin Xiang, which Boxer and Qing forces had besieged since 20 June. Diplomats, guards and civilians had held out for nearly two months; the court fled west and the Qing was forced into the settlement known as the Boxer Protocol.
entries.significanceZh: 北京之战结束了使馆围困，直接导致清朝签订《辛丑条约》，是义和团运动的结局性事件。
entries.significanceEn: The relief of the legations ended the siege and led directly to the Boxer Protocol, closing the Boxer crisis on foreign terms.
entries.notesZh: 北京在历史上多次发生同名战事（979、1215、1449、1644、1860年等），本条专指1900年义和团运动期间的解围战。
entries.notesEn: Beijing has seen many battles of the same name (979, 1215, 1449, 1644, 1860 and others); this entry is the 1900 relief of the legations during the Boxer Rebellion.

entries.summaryZh: 1942年6月3日至4日，日本海军以两艘航空母舰突袭阿拉斯加阿马克纳克岛的荷兰港美军基地，是阿留申群岛战役的前哨战。空袭未摧毁港口设施，日军随后占领基斯卡与阿图两岛，这是二战中日本唯一占领的北美领土，也是北美外围首次遭敌机轰炸。
entries.summaryEn: On 3 and 4 June 1942 the Imperial Japanese Navy sent two aircraft carriers to raid the Dutch Harbor naval base and Army post on Amaknak Island in Alaska, opening the Aleutian Islands campaign. The raid caused limited damage, but Japan went on to occupy Kiska and Attu, the only North American territory it held during the war.
entries.significanceZh: 荷兰港战役揭开了阿留申群岛战役，是二战中北美大陆外围首次遭敌机轰炸的事件。
entries.significanceEn: Dutch Harbor opened the Aleutian campaign and marked the first enemy air attack on North American soil in the Second World War.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均记6月3日至4日，本条只保留年份精度；阿马克纳克岛当时属阿拉斯加领地，并非美国本土州。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 3-4 June and the entry keeps year precision; Amaknak Island was then part of the Alaska Territory rather than a state.

entries.summaryZh: 621年5月，李世民率唐军在洛阳以东的虎牢关击溃窦建德统率的夏军主力，窦建德兵败被俘，困守洛阳的王世充随即出降。此役是唐初统一战争的决定性会战，一举消灭中原两大割据势力。李世民以少胜多、据险待疲的指挥也常被后世兵家称道。
entries.summaryEn: In May 621 Li Shimin led a smaller Tang army to Hulao Pass east of Luoyang and destroyed the Xia host of Dou Jiande, who was captured; Wang Shichong, besieged in Luoyang, surrendered soon afterwards. The victory eliminated the two strongest rival polities of the Central Plains and decided the Tang unification of China.
entries.significanceZh: 虎牢之战一举摧毁夏、郑两大割据政权，为唐朝统一中原奠定了基础。
entries.significanceEn: Hulao destroyed the Xia and Zheng regimes and secured Tang control of the Central Plains.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基系于武德四年五月，英文维基给出5月28日；本条只保留年份精度，不折算月日。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia dates the battle to the fifth month of Wude 4 while English Wikipedia gives 28 May; the entry keeps year precision.

entries.summaryZh: 1537年1月，西班牙远征军在艾尔南多·皮萨罗率领下突袭印加皇帝曼可·印加设在奥林太坦坡的大营。此前曼可·印加于1536年起兵围攻库斯科的西班牙驻军。印加军掘渠引水淹没平原，西班牙骑兵难以展开，被迫撤退。此役是印加抵抗中少见的胜利，但未能解除库斯科之围。
entries.summaryEn: In January 1537 a Spanish expedition under Hernando Pizarro raided the headquarters of the Inca emperor Manco Inca at Ollantaytambo, after Manco had risen in 1536 and besieged the Spanish garrison at Cusco. The Incas flooded the plain to hamper the cavalry and the Spaniards withdrew, a rare Inca success that failed to lift the siege of Cusco.
entries.significanceZh: 奥林太坦坡之战是印加反抗西班牙征服期间少有的战术胜利，显示了印加军队适应欧洲骑兵战法的能力。
entries.significanceEn: Ollantaytambo was one of the few Inca tactical successes against the conquest and showed how quickly Inca commanders adapted to European cavalry warfare.
entries.notesZh: 双方兵力数字分歧较大，本条只取大概而不采信单一数字；另有学者认为战场并不在城镇本身。
entries.notesEn: Troop figures differ widely between accounts and some scholars place the fighting outside the town; the entry adopts no single number.

entries.summaryZh: 1800年5月3日，莫罗指挥的法军与克雷统率的奥军在施托卡赫和恩根两地同时交战，属第二次反法同盟战争。恩根方向陷入僵持，法军勒古布部却夺下奥军主要补给基地施托卡赫，迫使克雷下令全线撤退。此役为法军随后控制南德意志打开了通路。
entries.summaryEn: On 3 May 1800, during the War of the Second Coalition, Moreau's French army fought Kray's Austrians at Engen and Stockach. The fighting at Engen stalled, but Claude Lecourbe's troops seized Stockach, the main Austrian supply base, forcing Kray to retreat and opening southern Germany to the French.
entries.significanceZh: 施托卡赫-恩根之战迫使奥军退出南德意志，为法军在1800年战局中的主动权奠定基础。
entries.significanceEn: Stockach-Engen pushed the Austrians out of southern Germany and gave the French the initiative in the 1800 campaign.
entries.notesZh: 施托卡赫在1799与1800年各有一次战事，本条专指1800年5月3日的双战场之战。
entries.notesEn: Stockach saw fighting in both 1799 and 1800; this entry is the twin engagement of 3 May 1800.

entries.summaryZh: 1937年6月4日，金日成指挥的朝鲜与中国游击队员越过满洲国与日治朝鲜的边界，袭击咸镜南道甲山郡的普天堡，击败当地日本守备队后撤回。朝鲜民主主义人民共和国长期把这次战斗宣传为金日成抗日武装斗争的代表性战功，其规模与指挥者在中外史学界仍有争议。
entries.summaryEn: On 4 June 1937 Korean and Chinese guerrillas commanded by Kim Il Sung crossed from Manchukuo into Japanese-ruled Korea and attacked Pochonbo in South Hamgyong, defeating the Japanese detachment before withdrawing. North Korea has since presented the raid as a founding deed of his anti-Japanese struggle, though its scale and command remain debated.
entries.significanceZh: 普天堡战斗的军事规模有限，却因朝鲜的长期宣传成为东北抗日游击战最具政治象征意义的行动之一。
entries.significanceEn: The raid was militarily small but became one of the most politically symbolic actions of the anti-Japanese guerrilla war through North Korean commemoration.
entries.notesZh: 中英文维基均记1937年6月4日；中文维基指出指挥者可能是崔贤而非金日成，本条在正文保留这一争议。
entries.notesEn: Both Wikipedia articles give 4 June 1937; Chinese Wikipedia notes that Choe Hyon rather than Kim Il Sung may have commanded, and the entry records the dispute.

entries.summaryZh: 1945年2月9日，英国皇家空军海岸司令部的英俊战士式战斗机在挪威弗勒峡湾攻击德国Z-33号驱逐舰及其护航舰艇，遭密集防空火力与德国空军第5战斗机联队拦截，损失惨重，幸存者称当日为黑色星期五。此役后，盟军把攻击商船的优先级置于军舰之上。
entries.summaryEn: On 9 February 1945 RAF Coastal Command Beaufighters attacked the German destroyer Z33 and its escorts in Forde Fjord, Norway, and ran into intense flak and Focke-Wulf 190s of JG 5. Seven Beaufighters fell to anti-aircraft fire and more were shot down by fighters, a loss the survivors called Black Friday.
entries.significanceZh: 黑色星期五促使盟军调整反舰攻击战术与目标优先级，是二战反舰航空作战的重要教训。
entries.significanceEn: Black Friday forced a rethink of Allied anti-shipping tactics and target priorities and became a noted lesson in wartime air operations.
entries.notesZh: 本条专指1945年2月9日挪威弗勒峡湾之战；英文维基同名页为消歧义页，引用其1945年子条目。
entries.notesEn: This entry is the Forde Fjord action of 9 February 1945; the English title is a disambiguation page and the 1945 article is cited instead.

entries.summaryZh: 2014年11月至2015年5月，伊斯兰国武装在伊拉克安巴尔省首府拉马迪与政府军反复争夺。2015年5月中旬，武装分子借沙尘暴掩护，以少量兵力突破六千守军的防线，5月17日完全控制城区。伊拉克军队此役失利，成为2014年后反恐战局中的重大挫折。
entries.summaryEn: From November 2014 to May 2015 Islamic State fighters fought Iraqi government forces for Ramadi, capital of Anbar Province. In mid-May 2015 a small force attacked under cover of a dust storm, broke through positions held by some six thousand troops and took the city by 17 May, a serious setback for Iraq and its allies.
entries.significanceZh: 拉马迪失守是2014年后伊拉克政府军最严重的挫败之一，直接促成国际联盟调整对伊支援。
entries.significanceEn: The loss of Ramadi was one of the gravest setbacks for Iraqi forces after 2014 and prompted changes in coalition support.
entries.notesZh: 中文维基记为2014年至2015年，本条按维基数据P585取起始年2014；平民死亡数字为估计值。
entries.notesEn: Chinese Wikipedia records 2014-2015 and the entry follows the Wikidata P585 start year of 2014; civilian death figures are estimates.
